# Terraform apply

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Apply a saved Terraform/OpenTofu plan, or run a fresh auto-approved apply

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/terraform-apply@v1
  with:
    working-directory: # Root module directory to apply.
```

## How it works

Apply a Terraform/OpenTofu change — by default, the exact plan that was reviewed.

`plan-file` is the intended path: a plan produced and reviewed earlier, downloaded as an
artifact, applied verbatim. Terraform refuses a stale saved plan if state moved
underneath it, which is the safety property you actually want — the alternative
(re-planning at apply time) silently applies something nobody looked at.

`plan-file: ''` falls back to a fresh `apply -auto-approve`. That's appropriate for
environments where plan review isn't a gate, and the action says so in the log.

`init` still has to run in the apply job: a downloaded plan file is useless without the
provider plugins and backend the job needs to talk to state.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `working-directory` | **yes** | — | Root module directory to apply. |
| `binary` | no | `terraform` | terraform \| tofu |
| `plan-file` | no | `tfplan.binary` | Saved binary plan to apply, relative to `working-directory`. Empty runs a fresh `apply -auto-approve` instead. |
| `init-args` | no | `""` | Extra args appended to `init`. |
| `backend-config` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `key=value` backend settings or `.hcl` paths. |
| `workspace` | no | `""` | Workspace to select. Must match the one the plan was made in. |
| `var-files` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `.tfvars` paths. Only used for a fresh apply. |
| `vars` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `key=value` pairs. Only used for a fresh apply. |
| `destroy` | no | `false` | true to destroy. Only used for a fresh apply. |
| `parallelism` | no | `10` | Concurrent resource operations. |
| `apply-args` | no | `""` | Extra args appended to `apply`. |
| `outputs-file` | no | `""` | Write root module outputs as JSON to this path. Empty to skip. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `outputs-json` | Root module outputs as a compact JSON object. Values marked `sensitive` in Terraform are replaced with `null` — GitHub does not mask step outputs, so sensitive values must not travel this way. |
| `outputs-file` | Path the full outputs JSON was written to, when requested. |
